before.overview: A five-year Bachelor of Occupational Therapy at Sri Ramachandra Faculty of Occupational Therapy: four academic years with supervised clinical training or field work each year, then a one-year compulsory rotatory internship. Foreign nationals are admitted on merit from their 10+2 results.

eligibility.intro: SRIHER's 2026-27 foreign-national prospectus sets these requirements for international BOT applicants.
items: Pass in 10+2 or equivalent with at least 50 per cent aggregate in Physics, Chemistry and Biology (Botany and Zoology).
Applicants who studied abroad must hold a qualification judged equivalent under UGC guidelines, with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English passed at 12th-standard level.
Minimum age of 17 years as on 31 December 2026.
A physical fitness certificate from an authorised medical attendant is required at admission.

applicationSteps: Download the 2026-27 Foreign National undergraduate application from the SRIHER admissions page; there is no application fee in the international category.
Email the signed form and scanned documents to the International Relations Office at admissions.international@sriramachandra.edu.in, filing one application per programme.
The Admissions Committee and International Relations Office check eligibility and documents, and may hold an online interview.
Eligible applicants receive an Offer of Provisional Admission and pay the first fee instalment by the date stated in it.
After payment and submission of final school results, SRIHER issues a Confirmation of Provisional Admission Letter.
Apply for an Indian student visa with the confirmation letter, then report on the notified date for original-document verification.
Complete FRRO registration after arrival; SRIHER files the Form II and Form III registrations within 24 hours of admission.

academic: Class 10 and Class 12 mark statements, or O Level and A Level certificates including Advanced Level courses
UGC equivalence certificate for foreign school qualifications
NEET score where NCAHP rules require it
Grade-to-percentage conversion sheet issued by the school where results are graded
application: Signed Foreign National application form with photograph
Passport first and last pages
Visa, OCI card or Nepal or Bhutan citizenship card where held
Transfer, conduct and migration certificates
Proof of date of birth and four passport-size photographs

before.deadlinesNote: For 2026-27 the last date for foreign-national undergraduate applications was 30 June 2026, with first-year classes starting around the second week of July 2026.

Health insurance is mandatory for foreign students and is charged at USD 50 a year.

before.overview: A two-year, four-semester Master of Public Health at Sri Ramachandra Faculty of Public Health with four elective streams: Occupational and Environmental Health, Public Health Nutrition, Health Systems Management, and Climate Change and Human Health. It ends with a field practicum, dissertation and internship.

eligibility.intro: SRIHER accepts a wide range of first degrees for the MPH, from institutions recognised by NMC, AICTE or UGC or their foreign equivalents.
items: Bachelor's degree in public health, environmental health sciences, medicine, AYUSH, dentistry or veterinary sciences.
Or a bachelor's degree in paramedical or allied health sciences, life sciences, B.Tech or B.E.
Or a degree in statistics, biostatistics, demography, population studies, nutrition, sociology, psychology, anthropology or social work.
Equivalent undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in engineering or basic and applied science are also accepted.

applicationSteps: Register on the Government of India Study in India portal to obtain an SII ID; this applies to foreign nationals needing a visa, OCI cardholders and Nepal or Bhutan citizens.

The Admissions Committee and International Relations Office review eligibility and documents, and may hold an online interview.
Eligible applicants receive an Offer of Provisional Admission and pay the first fee instalment within the stated deadline.
SRIHER issues a Confirmation of Admission Letter, used to apply for the student visa through the Study in India portal.
Report on the notified date for original-document verification, then complete FRRO registration.

after.overview: A two-year, four-semester Master of Public Health at Sri Ramachandra Faculty of Public Health with four elective streams: Occupational and Environmental Health, Public Health Nutrition, Health Systems Management, and Climate Change and Human Health. It ends with a field practicum, dissertation and internship.

eligibility.intro: SRIHER accepts a wide range of first degrees for the MPH, from institutions recognised by NMC, AICTE or UGC or their foreign equivalents.
items: Bachelor's degree in public health, environmental health sciences, medicine, AYUSH, dentistry or veterinary sciences.
Or a bachelor's degree in paramedical or allied health sciences, life sciences, B.Tech or B.E.
Or a degree in statistics, biostatistics, demography, population studies, nutrition, sociology, psychology, anthropology or social work.
Equivalent undergraduate or postgraduate degrees in engineering or basic and applied science are also accepted.

applicationSteps: Register on the Government of India Study in India portal to obtain an SII ID; this applies to foreign nationals needing a visa, OCI cardholders and Nepal or Bhutan citizens.
Download the 2026-27 postgraduate application from the SRIHER admissions page and email it with enclosures to admissions.international@sriramachandra.edu.in.
The Admissions Committee and International Relations Office review eligibility and documents, and may hold an online interview.
Eligible applicants receive an Offer of Provisional Admission and pay the first fee instalment within the stated deadline.
SRIHER issues a Confirmation of Admission Letter, used to apply for the student visa through the Study in India portal.
Report on the notified date for original-document verification, then complete FRRO registration.
